title: Light curve inspector and labeler

author.name: phuijse
author.field: Astronomy: time-domain photometry of periodic variable stars

notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Shows survey light curves of variable stars nine to a page, each folded at the reported period and at twice that period, so a person can label each one RR Lyrae, Eclipsing Binary, Cepheid or Other. Several people can label the same set under separate usernames. The output is one label array per user, saved as resultfolder/<username>/backup.pkl (-1 means unlabeled) and restored at that user's next log-in. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
